newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-LOGRONES FIRE COACH AFTER SIDE LETS IN 15 GOALS IN A WEEK.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LOGRONES FIRE COACH AFTER SIDE LETS IN 15 GOALS IN A WEEK.

text.p: Spanish first division side Logrones sacked coach Miguel Angel Lotina on Monday after 15 goals were scored against them in three matches in one week.
Lotina, who became the first managerial casualty of the new season, had seen his side go down 8-0 to Barcelona, 1-0 to Valladolid and 6-0 to Athletic Bilbao.
